name: indexed traversal and conditional maximum
code: public int getLongestHomeWinStreak(){int longest=0,current=0;for(int i=0;i<allGames.size();i++){Game match=allGames.get(i);if(match.getAwayScore()>=match.getHomeScore())current=0;else current=current+1;if(current>longest)longest=current;}return longest;}

name: substring traversal instead of indexOf

name: nested search of each possible start
code: public int findFreeBlock(int period,int duration){for(int start=0;start+duration<=60;start++){boolean free=true;for(int offset=0;offset<duration;offset++)if(!isMinuteFree(period,start+offset))free=false;if(free)return start;}return -1;} public boolean makeAppointment(int first,int last,int duration){int period=first;while(period<=last){int start=findFreeBlock(period,duration);if(start!=-1){reserveBlock(period,start,duration);return true;}period++;}return false;}
